Name: Pokemon Fish
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
currently includes 24 fish, 7 foragables, and 2 crabpot fish (+ 12 shiny variants)~

. ☆  . • ☆ . ° .• °:. *₊ ° . ☆

[img]https://imgur.com/4pncZL1.png[/img]
1. download and install content patcher and farm type manager
2. download this mod
3. unzip contents into stardew's mod folder

[img]https://imgur.com/e6yXfxu.png[/img]
♡ i plan to add more fish and shiny variants in the future
♡ pond luvdisc can produce heart scales
♡ sprites made by me with the exception of the kyogre and blue orb sprites, which were made by Suki (salgadozer)~
